purpose: Provide a canonical intake template for future Mega Drive AAA video transcripts, AI summaries, direct video notes or external technique analyses.
intake_policy: Every new source must be classified before techniques are accepted.
Every accepted technique must map to at least one owner skill and one evidence path.
Every rejected or deferred claim must be recorded with a reason.
Aggregate claims cannot update canonical counts without individual source records.
No intake record can promote runtime, ROM, budget or AAA status by itself.

source_identity.title: human-readable source title
source_identity.source_uri_or_local_path: optional source link or local attachment path

source_reliability.initial_level: L0_unavailable | L1_indirect_ai_summary | L2_timestamped_transcript | L3_primary_doc_or_tool_verified | L4_local_runtime_verified | L5_canonical_validated

technique_extraction.sgdk_or_vdp_mapping: concrete Mega Drive/SGDK constraint or behavior
